# Synthetic mini Technic library

A tiny library in the layout of the LDraw Parts Library (`ldraw/parts`, `ldraw/p`), **written for the tests, CC0**: the shapes are boxes and 16-sided prisms generated by `generate.py`; nothing is copied from the LDraw library. The part and primitive names are LDraw's (`3701`, `3673`, `connect.dat`, `clip3.dat`, `joint8ball.dat`, `clh1.dat` ...) because the importer and the joint table (`standards/joints-v1.json`) recognise primitives by name.

| Part | Shape | Connectors the importer derives |
|---|---|---|
| `3701` Technic brick 1 x 4 with holes | three round holes (radius 8) along X | 4 studs, 3 pin holes |
| `3704` Technic brick 1 x 2 with axle hole | a cross-shaped hole along X | 2 studs, an axle hole |
| `3673` Technic pin | two 20 LDU shafts of radius 6 | 2 pin connectors |
| `3705` Technic axle 4 | an 80 LDU cross | 4 axle connectors |
| `3005` brick 1 x 1 | hollow, no mask | a stud, a receptacle |
| `4085` plate with clip, `87994` bar 3L | a ring clip, a cylinder | a clip (`clip3`), a bar |
| `22890` ball, `14418` socket | a block ball and a shell | a ball, a socket |
| `9101`, `9102` hinge plates | two fingers, one finger (`clh4`, `clh1`) | even and odd hinge halves |
| `9103` plate with `clip4` | a clip the joint table does not calibrate | flagged, studs only |

Used by `crates/openbrick-catalog/tests/technic.rs`, `crates/openbrick-engine/tests/technic.rs` and the Build smoke test (`node apps/web/smoke.mjs --only-technic`).
